answer: Proof of Agent binds every identity to bonded collateral and analyzes cross-identity signatures. If k identities coordinate an equivocation, correlated penalties grow as O(k^2) across their escrows; detection then applies an exponential multiplier to capital loss, with asymmetric depreciation. Thus a swarm cannot profit by hiding behind a knoll, quartz token, or pigment-level disguise: correlation makes control increasingly ruinous.
